ARTIST STATEMENT / INTERACTIVE PHOTOGRAPHIC WORK

The Thickness of Time

One room is photographed again and again. People enter and leave; furniture shifts; daylight changes. The room appears continuous, but its moments refuse to stay separate.

Choose which moments are allowed to coexist, or use all fourteen. Three ways to look: OVERLAY lets moments occupy one place; SLICES makes vertical sections of different times; DEPTH restores the distant view, window, floor and foreground as separate spatial planes, while glimpses of other moments appear between them.

Move your viewpoint to uncover overlapping photographic times. Different parts of the room preserve different traces. The work does not reconstruct the past as a seamless three-dimensional world. It makes the limits of each photographic instant visible.

Based on fourteen original photographs from OUR TIME — 2026 SUMMER by Youn Sungmin. The timeline represents their sequence in the artist book, not verified capture dates. Sound is synthesized live from the selected moments: shifts of light and viewpoint reshape short-lived resonances, breath-like textures, and melodic fragments. Sound begins only when activated by the visitor.

같은 방을 반복해서 촬영한 열네 장의 사진. 관객이 시점을 이동하면 지나간 순간들이 공간의 서로 다른 위치에서 겹쳐 나타납니다. 이 작품은 실제 방의 정밀한 3D 복원이 아닌, 사진으로 구성한 시간의 공간적 탐구입니다.

HOW TO EXPLORE / QUICK GUIDE

How to explore this room

1. Choose a view

OVERLAY lets different times coexist, SLICES divides them, and DEPTH creates spatial layers.

OVERLAY는 시간의 겹침, SLICES는 분할, DEPTH는 공간의 깊이입니다.
2. Choose photographs

Open CHOOSE PHOTOS and tick several moments. Then press COMBINE SELECTED.

CHOOSE PHOTOS에서 여러 장을 선택한 뒤 COMBINE SELECTED를 누르세요.
3. Explore by dragging

Drag left or right to discover other moments. In DEPTH, the window, floor, and foreground move at different distances.

좌우로 드래그하면 다른 시간이 드러납니다. DEPTH에서는 공간층의 움직임을 느낄 수 있습니다.
4. Watch the sequence

Press WATCH to follow the chosen moments, or use the timeline to skip ahead. The view can be changed from VIEW.

WATCH로 감상하고 재생 막대를 움직일 수 있습니다. VIEW에서 보기 방식을 바꿀 수 있습니다.
SOUND: switch on sound to hear the room respond. The selected moments and your movement change the sound. It remains OFF until you activate it. 윗부분의 SOUND를 눌러 켜면, 선택한 사진과 움직임에 따라 공명음이 바뀝니다.
Choose two or more photographs to discover how times coexist. You can always return to all fourteen. 사진을 여러 장 선택해 시간을 구성하고, USE ALL 14로 언제든 원래대로 돌아올 수 있습니다.
